native_prior_contract.conditional_nuisance: Original source conditional nuisance prior at retained source mass, eta, chi_eff, z; no hidden-spin prior change
native_prior_contract.density_convention: Native retained prior proportional to (1+z)^2 J(Mc_source,eta) p_chi(chi|q) p_native_DL(DL(z)) dDLcommon/dz. No population rho.

known_issues.evidence: Public availability does not certify waveform/calibration/window systematics or arbitrary prior changes.

provenance_gaps: Public source eligibility is independent of scientific recovery and historical source-quality issues.
Source metadata records the internal path of the byte-identical file read on CIT; the public proof binds it to the release file.

priors.description: Original native retained and conditional nuisance priors of the proven public file; the effective-spin prior is the fit base measure and cancels in the scalar likelihood; mass and distance priors are divided out
priors.measure: Detector component-mass and native luminosity-distance/spin priors; see exact native contract

native_prior_contract.conditional_nuisance: Original source conditional nuisance prior at retained source mass, eta, chi_eff, z; no hidden-spin prior change
native_prior_contract.density_convention: Native retained prior proportional to (1+z)^2 J(Mc_source,eta) p_chi(chi|q) p_native_DL(DL(z)) dDLcommon/dz. No population rho.

known_issues.evidence: Public availability does not certify waveform/calibration/window systematics or arbitrary prior changes.

provenance_gaps: Public source eligibility is independent of scientific recovery and historical source-quality issues.
Source metadata records the internal path of the byte-identical file read on CIT; the public proof binds it to the release file.

priors.description: Original native retained and conditional nuisance priors of the proven public file; the effective-spin prior is the fit base measure and cancels in the scalar likelihood; mass and distance priors are divided out
priors.measure: Detector component-mass and native luminosity-distance/spin priors; see exact native contract

native_prior_contract.conditional_nuisance: Original source conditional nuisance prior at retained source mass, eta, chi_eff, z; no hidden-spin prior change
native_prior_contract.density_convention: Native retained prior proportional to (1+z)^2 J(Mc_source,eta) p_chi(chi|q) p_native_DL(DL(z)) dDLcommon/dz. No population rho.

known_issues.evidence: Public availability does not certify waveform/calibration/window systematics or arbitrary prior changes.

provenance_gaps: Public source eligibility is independent of scientific recovery and historical source-quality issues.
Source metadata records the internal path of the byte-identical file read on CIT; the public proof binds it to the release file.

priors.description: Original native retained and conditional nuisance priors of the proven public file; the effective-spin prior is the fit base measure and cancels in the scalar likelihood; mass and distance priors are divided out
priors.measure: Detector component-mass and native luminosity-distance/spin priors; see exact native contract

native_prior_contract.conditional_nuisance: Original source conditional nuisance prior at retained source mass, eta, chi_eff, z; no hidden-spin prior change
native_prior_contract.density_convention: Native retained prior proportional to (1+z)^2 J(Mc_source,eta) p_chi(chi|q) p_native_DL(DL(z)) dDLcommon/dz. No population rho.

known_issues.evidence: Public availability does not certify waveform/calibration/window systematics or arbitrary prior changes.

provenance_gaps: Public source eligibility is independent of scientific recovery and historical source-quality issues.
Source metadata records the internal path of the byte-identical file read on CIT; the public proof binds it to the release file.

priors.description: Original native retained and conditional nuisance priors of the proven public file; the effective-spin prior is the fit base measure and cancels in the scalar likelihood; mass and distance priors are divided out
priors.measure: Detector component-mass and native luminosity-distance/spin priors; see exact native contract

native_prior_contract.conditional_nuisance: Original source conditional nuisance prior at retained source mass, eta, chi_eff, z; no hidden-spin prior change
native_prior_contract.density_convention: Native retained prior proportional to (1+z)^2 J(Mc_source,eta) p_chi(chi|q) p_native_DL(DL(z)) dDLcommon/dz. No population rho.

known_issues.evidence: Public availability does not certify waveform/calibration/window systematics or arbitrary prior changes.

provenance_gaps: Public source eligibility is independent of scientific recovery and historical source-quality issues.
Source metadata records the internal path of the byte-identical file read on CIT; the public proof binds it to the release file.

priors.description: Original native retained and conditional nuisance priors of the proven public file; the effective-spin prior is the fit base measure and cancels in the scalar likelihood; mass and distance priors are divided out
priors.measure: Detector component-mass and native luminosity-distance/spin priors; see exact native contract

native_prior_contract.conditional_nuisance: Original source conditional nuisance prior at retained source mass, eta, chi_eff, z; no hidden-spin prior change
native_prior_contract.density_convention: Native retained prior proportional to (1+z)^2 J(Mc_source,eta) p_chi(chi|q) p_native_DL(DL(z)) dDLcommon/dz. No population rho.

known_issues.evidence: Public availability does not certify waveform/calibration/window systematics or arbitrary prior changes.

provenance_gaps: Public source eligibility is independent of scientific recovery and historical source-quality issues.
Source metadata records the internal path of the byte-identical file read on CIT; the public proof binds it to the release file.

priors.description: Original native retained and conditional nuisance priors of the proven public file; the effective-spin prior is the fit base measure and cancels in the scalar likelihood; mass and distance priors are divided out
priors.measure: Detector component-mass and native luminosity-distance/spin priors; see exact native contract
